limitations: Map original test points to the implemented topology before evaluating; do not tune against all observations and reuse them as held-out validation.
Source sharpness check is visual under specified conditions and is not converted to an invented numeric spot tolerance.
The waveform figures specify amplitude guidelines but generally do not print DC level, period or pulse width; null fields record those omissions, not zero.
The point-16 amplitude is an 8–25 Vpp range and must not be collapsed to a nominal target.
Model-node mapping is based on the .11/.21 schematic and its existing KiCad transcription; connector and diode orientation remain subject to the A1 independent source review.

adjustment_procedure.name: regulated 5 V
adjustment_procedure.action: With 12.0 ± 0.3 V supply, set R9 on 012-6931 to 5.000 ± 0.015 V at X3:3.

adjustment_procedure.name: synchronization pattern
adjustment_procedure.action: Place H at the first and last character positions of a line; turn brightness to the right stop, then R28 until the base raster is visible.

adjustment_procedure.name: vertical synchronization
adjustment_procedure.action: Set R22 near the center of the range that remains vertically synchronized.

adjustment_procedure.name: T1 alignment
adjustment_procedure.action: Adjust oscillator coil T1 to 2.0 ± 0.2 V DC at X12:1, or 2.2 ± 0.2 V in 1 kByte mode.

adjustment_procedure.name: horizontal hold
adjustment_procedure.action: Set R24 so the picture is nearly symmetrical about the raster and 5–10 mm from the right raster edge; if impossible, remove C9 or use 680 pF for 1 kByte mode.

adjustment_procedure.name: maximum beam current
adjustment_procedure.action: Connect the digital voltmeter to neck-board connector X3 with cable 1.11.017154.0 and display the full-bright Figure 7 pattern. Set brightness and contrast to minimum, turn R28 to complete darkness, then raise it until traces are just visible while the meter rises no more than 0.1 mV above its dark reading. Set both controls to maximum and adjust R4 on board 012-6921 to a 3.6 mV meter reading.

adjustment_procedure.name: geometry preparation
adjustment_procedure.action: Use the Figure 7 grid and ruler, center-row baseline horizontal, yoke seated at tube neck, centering rings at minimum effect, maximum brightness.

adjustment_procedure.name: horizontal geometry
adjustment_procedure.action: Equalize grid widths with L3; set 210 mm picture width with R5; center with R4, and if its range is insufficient change bridge E1–E4 as described, then repeat. Verify Rx=23–28 mm.

adjustment_procedure.name: vertical geometry
adjustment_procedure.action: Iterate R35 height, R60 lower linearity, R59 upper linearity and R58 vertical shift; set 145 mm height and verify Ry ranges for 1/2 kByte modes.

adjustment_procedure.name: edge geometry
adjustment_procedure.action: Use yoke correction magnets when outside grid borders show barrel or pincushion distortion; repeat interacting geometry adjustments.

adjustment_limitations: The manual gives a focus visibility criterion but pages 29–32 do not prescribe a separate electrical focus trim setting.
The 3.6 mV beam-current setup is a reading in the manual procedure, not a conversion to model beam current without the specified meter/load.

Page 15's circuit prose assigns R59 to middle/lower and R60 to upper vertical linearity, while the adjustment instructions on page 32 call R60 lower and R59 upper. The page-15 copy carries a handwritten correction mark; inspect the schematic and physical controls before applying either assignment.
The real setup uses iterative trims; a future calibration freeze must record actual chosen positions and observations.
